_meta.whatThisFileIs: THE FIGMA MAP. Which Figma node each component came from. Three files in this repository are called some version of 'registry' — this is the one that records the design relationship, NOT the one that decides what may be rendered. The allowlist is frontend/src/shared/tag-registry.ts; the schema the server validates against is frontend/src/components/A2UI/catalogs/<pipeline>/catalog.json.
_meta.description: Registry of existing Lit components in this repository. The AI is a COMPOSER, not a BUILDER. Before generating any component, look up its figmaName here. If present, import it — do NOT regenerate. If absent, ask before building.

annotationChannel.note: TWO attributes, not one — and they carry DIFFERENT halves of the spec. `data-annotations` holds the STATE note ("...yellow when it's selected and transparent when the chat is closed..."); `data-interaction-annotations` holds the INTERACTION note (the `On click:` contract). Both match /^data-.*annotation/i, so a regex matcher catches them, but an implementation that expects a SINGLE attribute silently loses the `On click:` half — the one field that makes behaviour verbatim instead of invented. The REST node.annotations[] carries the same two notes. SUPERSEDES an earlier record of `attributeNameFound: null`: that was an artifact of a layout-only Figma tool that dropped annotation attributes, NOT a property of this design — the names are observable, and were observed.
annotationChannel.namesMustStayUntrusted: Match by regex and record what was seen. §2 of the pipeline rules forbids hardcoding the name; §9.3's recorded name is stale (see below).
